subject: Migrate the remaining cluster tests to the new framework and remove legacy files (#2297) (#3382)
reason: The change migrates legacy Tcl cluster tests (failover loop, resharding, replica migration, cluster shards) to the new test framework and deletes the old tests/cluster/ harness, runtest-cluster, and updates the daily CI workflow accordingly. No file under src/ is modified, so no server, tool, or protocol behaviour changes; it is a test/CI-only refactor with nothing for the fuzzer to exercise.
